name: forge-monorepo
description: QuantForge — editor-native coding agent for VS Code, agent loop on TrueForge

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/diff-engine packages/context-engine packages/editor-mcp packages/trueforge-client packages/extension
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && cd packages/extension && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --target $(node -p "process.platform+'-'+process.arch") -o forge-$(node -p "process.platform+'-'+process.arch").vsix
